summary: Inspected the pie chart and confirmed the printed labels (Nuclear 45%, Fossil Fuels 30%, Renewables 15%, Hydroelectric 10%) and their visual slice areas. The existing chains cover both label-based and area-based interpretations, both pointing to Nuclear. The main remaining limit is whether the visual geometry exactly matches the printed percentages, and whether the option set fully covers all possible routing outcomes for the largest category.
